tagline: Where you get dropped into places you'd never survive.
promise: Every video puts you inside a different world and asks one question: how badly would this go for you?
voice: Second person ('you'), about ten minutes, original art, one new video every week.
worlds: Haunted mazes, ruined planets, fictional empires, real history at its worst; full stories of games, shows and strange corners of the universe.

formats.title: Why It Sucks To Be {who} in {world}

footer:
Welcome to Ladeeda Worlds, where you get dropped into places you'd never survive. Every video puts you inside a different world and asks one question: how badly would this go for you?

New videos every week. Subscribe, and try not to get lost.
pinned_comment_style: A second-person dilemma from the episode, ending with 👇 (e.g. 'Would you hide, or reveal yourself and save your twin? 👇')
description_opener_style: Two or three punchy second-person lines that drop the viewer into the world ('You're the Avatar. The most powerful person alive. And in Seven Havens, that's the worst thing you could be.')
